subject.name: Machine setters, operators, and tenders
subject.summary: The frozen machine setters, operators, and tenders correspond to O*NET51-7042.00, and in practice this is the setup, operation, and tending of non-sawing woodworking machinery. Equipment includes drilling, turning, shaping, milling, sanding, planing, and wood nailing machines, and CNC may be used. Tasks include checking work orders and lumber, equipment setup and running monitoring, workpiece dimension and shape inspection, marking and transfer, and maintenance and cleaning, with specific machines following training and in-factory procedures. It is not road paving or all machinery repair; positions mainly involving CNC programming and operation still need their statistical classification verified by main tasks. The paper hole-spacing problem does not substitute for physical items or equipment training.
